21	The `lz4` command line tool provides file compression and decompression:

24	
25	```bash
26	lz4 [OPTIONS] [-|INPUT-FILE] <OUTPUT-FILE>
27	```

36

42	- `-r` - Recursive mode (directories)

#!/bin/bash
# Differential test: my single-block fast compression vs reference CLI block bytes.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
REF=./executable
gcc -O2 -o tests/blktest tests/blktest.c src/lz4block.c || exit 1

mkdir -p tests/tmp
pass=0; fail=0
for f in "$@"; do
  sz=$(stat -c%s "$f")
  if [ "$sz" -gt 4194304 ]; then echo "skip $f (too big)"; continue; fi
  $REF -qf "$f" tests/tmp/ref.lz4
  # extract first block from frame (assumes no content size, no block checksum)
  python3 - "$f" <<'EOF'
import struct,sys
d=open('tests/tmp/ref.lz4','rb').read()
flg=d[4]; pos=7
if flg&8: pos+=8
sz=struct.unpack('<I',d[pos:pos+4])[0]; pos+=4
raw=sz&0x80000000; sz&=0x7fffffff
blk=d[pos:pos+sz]
open('tests/tmp/ref.block','wb').write(blk)
print("raw" if raw else "lz4", sz)
EOF
  tests/blktest c "$f" tests/tmp/my.block 2>/dev/null
  if cmp -s tests/tmp/ref.block tests/tmp/my.block; then
    pass=$((pass+1)); # echo "OK  $f"
  else
    fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL $f (my=$(stat -c%s tests/tmp/my.block) ref=$(stat -c%s tests/tmp/ref.block))"
  fi
done
echo "pass=$pass fail=$fail"
